thread:
Jamie L: Hey team — scheduling final release planning sync for release 2.4. Want to lock a 30m slot this week to walk the rollout checklist, owners, and contingency. Options: Wed 9:30-10:00, Thu 13:30-14:00, Fri 10:00-10:30. Please react with :thumbsup: to the slot you prefer, or reply if none work. Draft agenda below — pls add items or owners.

Sarah M: :thumbsup: for Thu 13:30.

Mike R: Wed 9:30 works for infra lead as well.

Anita P: Fri 10:00 ok for me but I can't do Thu.

Jamie L: Noted. If Thu gets the most thumbs we'll move it. Current draft agenda:
```
1) Quick status (5m) — owners confirm block/merge status
2) Rollout plan & smoke tests (10m) — infra + eng
2.a) Post-deploy health window (3h) — ops
3) Stakeholder signoffs (5m) — security/compliance
4) Fallback & rollback steps (5m) — ops
5) Customer comms & timing (2m)
6) Final decision & action items (5m)
```
Please add owners for each item inline.

release-bot: Reminder: the release checklist doc needs approvals from @security-team and @legal by EOD Thu.

Sarah M: I'll own #1 and will ping product for acceptance tests.

Mike R: I'll pick up #2 and #4. Will add the smoke test runbook and rollback script dry-run to the doc.

Anita P: I'll chase security signoff — pinging @sec_ana now. Also proposing explicit post-deploy health checks (latency, error rate, DB queue depth) during the 3h window.

Jamie L: Added Anita as owner for #3. Adding "post-deploy health window (3h)" as 2.a. Mike — can you confirm canary capacity and thresholds?

Mike R: Yes. Plan: 2% canary in one AZ, monitor for 30m, if OK move to 25%. Thresholds: error rate <0.5% and p95 latency within 1.5x baseline. I'll include these in the runbook.

Sarah M: Two quick asks: 1) Who's covering customer comms? 2) Can we run a dry-run of the rollback script by Wed EOD?

Jamie L: Good asks. Sarah — can you own comms? Mike — can you do the rollback dry-run? I'll send the calendar invite once we have majority availability and owners confirmed.

Anita P: I'll confirm security approval ETA by Wed noon and post here.

Sarah M: Done — I'll own comms. Adding a 2-minute line to the agenda for customer comms timeline.

Jamie L: Thanks everyone. Tentative meeting set for Thu 13:30 if no objections. If you can't make it, drop blockers here and we'll record the meeting and capture action items.
